Pipeline Leak, River MM 303, LA

2012-06-13
On 13JUN12, USCG MSU Baton Rouge contacted NOAA SSC about a pipeline leak occurring at Mississippi River Mile Marker 303. USCG vessel and overflight is reporting a 17 mile sheen with streamers of darker brown product. The quantity and product is still under investigation and no responsible party has been identified. USCG is requesting a trajectory.
